title: Evaluating AIGC Detectors on Code Content

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the detection performance (AUC, FPR, FNR) of AIGC detectors on natural language datasets versus code-related datasets to identify performance disparities across domains.

Evaluating and comparing the detection performance of AIGC detectors across code snippets written in six different programming languages (Go, Java, JavaScript, PHP, Python, Ruby) to identify disparities in detection accuracy.

Analyzing the False Positive Rates (FPR) and False Negative Rates (FNR) of AIGC detectors to determine if they exhibit a systematic bias toward over-predicting content as either human-written (negative cases) or AI-generated (positive cases).
